name: rico-skills
summary: Claude Code skills that write recommendation articles, apply 20 website themes and turn any site into design system docs.
description: Three installable Claude Code skills for content and design work: rico-resource-article builds curated recommendation articles from a topic through multi-turn confirmation, with optional screenshots via ScreenshotOne or urlscan.io; rico-ui-ux-themes applies one of 20 built-in themes to a website or derives a theme from any site, with natural-language fine-tuning; rico-design-md converts a website URL into design system documents and converts between DESIGN.md, tokens.json (DTCG), variables.css, theme.css (Tailwind v4) and a standalone preview.html.
contains: 20 built-in themes: developer, AI, enterprise, creative, e-commerce and brand styles
rico-design-md outputs DESIGN.md, preview.html, tokens.json (DTCG), variables.css, theme.css
converts between DESIGN.md, tokens.json, variables.css and theme.css
extracts colors, typography, spacing, shadows and component styles from any URL
optional screenshots via ScreenshotOne or urlscan.io
installs via quick install or plugin marketplace
